compiled_state.title: As a DSO completion-verifier, I need every gate override to emit a structured log entry so that bypass patterns are visible in the artifact bundle and not silently discarded
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Summary
Every sprint closure gate override emits a structured bypass-log entry (rationale + caller context) that is included in the completion-verifier artifact bundle. Overrides without log entries are hard errors.

## Done Definitions
- Structured bypass-log entry written on each override (rationale + caller context)
- Log entry included in completion-verifier artifact bundle
- Override without bypass log is a hard error (gate refuses override)
- Integration test: override -> log entry present in artifact

## Considerations
- S3+S6+S11 all modify sprint Phase I closure block. Coordinate edits to avoid conflicts: S3 adds handoff gate, S6 adds bypass surveillance, S11 validates Phase I behavior. Sequence: implement S3 first, S6 second, validate S11 last.
- Config key namespace: coordinate with S4 and S7 to avoid collisions on config fields added by this story.

## SC Coverage
SC6

## Depends On
S3 (closure gate protocol must be finalized before bypass log format is defined)

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
